top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) honours a new chemical mode of action: a small molecule acts as a catalytic bridge that recruits an E3 ligase so the cell's ubiquitin-proteasome system removes the target. The ternary-complex mechanism and cereblon as the thalidomide target are confirmed across many laboratories, and the three names span concept (PROTACs) and mechanism (cereblon, which links the glue strand to the PROTAC strand). The absence of an approved degrader is a timing risk, not a defect in the science. The cut excludes Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Ito and Kim, which is a real cost, but the citation can be worded to name both induced proximity and the cereblon mechanism. P003 is the more mature fallback, P002 has the cleanest attribution but sits closest to the 2010 cross-coupling prize, and no award ranks last because several mature achievements are available.
